[[Madison Square Garden]] |champion= |bowl= [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = round of 64 }} {{2014-15 Big East Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2014–15 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team''' represented [[St. John's University (New York City)|St. John's University]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was coached by [[Steve Lavin]] in his fifth year at the school. St. John's home games were played at [[Carnesecca Arena]] and [[Madison Square Garden]] and the team was members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 21–12, 10–8 in Big East play to finish in fifth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2015 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] to Providence. They received an at-large bid to the [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the first round to San Diego State. On March 27, 2015 St. John's and head coach Steve Lavin mutually agreed to part ways.{{cite web|last=Eisenberg|first=Jeff|title=Steve Lavin out at St. John's after five up-and-down seasons|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/blogs/ncaab-the-dagger/steve-lavin-out-at-st--john-s-after-five-up-and-down-seasons-192211667.html|work=sports.yahoo|accessdate=27 March 2015|date=March 27, 2015}} ==Previous season== The [[2013–14 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|Red Storm]] finished the season 20–13, 10–8 in Big East play to finish in three-way tie for third place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2014 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] to Providence. They were invited to the [[2014 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they lost to [[2013–14 Robert Morris Colonials men's basketball team|Robert Morris]] in the first round. ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
